mobile.title: Desktop Recommended
mobile.text: coOCR/HTR is optimized for large screens to display document, editor, and validation panels simultaneously.

viewer.title: Document Viewer
viewer.tooltipText: Supports images (JPG, PNG) and PAGE-XML. Zoom with mouse wheel, pan by dragging.
viewer.hint: Load a demo document or upload an image (JPG, PNG) or PAGE-XML.
viewer.dropText: Drag & drop images or PAGE-XML files

editor.title: Description / Transcription
editor.tooltipDesc1: The LLM creates an initial draft which you correct and validate as an expert.
editor.tooltipDesc2: As configured in the user prompt, the LLM generates a visual description of the document page.
editor.hint: Click "Transcribe" to process the document with AI. Double-click to edit.

validation.title: Validation / LLM Review
validation.tooltipText: Combines deterministic validation with LLM Review. Categories: confident / uncertain / problematic (no percentages).
validation.tooltipThinkingText: Watch the LLM's reasoning process in real time. This helps you understand how the model approaches your document and refine your prompts accordingly.
validation.hint: Validation checks transcription for errors and uncertainties.
validation.emptyText: Load a document and run transcription to see validation results here.
validation.ruleBasedHint: Local, fast checks without API calls
validation.customPromptHint: Overrides the default LLM Review prompt. Use {text} as placeholder for the transcription.
validation.postProcessHint: Select which review stages to run
validation.paleographicHint: Minim disambiguation, letter confusion, abbreviation signs
validation.philologicalHint: Morphology, syntax, formulaic patterns, lexical plausibility
validation.promptProfileHint: Choose a document scenario profile for Stage 1/2/3 prompts.
validation.advancedOverridesHint: If filled, overrides replace profile/default prompts for the stage.

llmConfig.title: LLM Configuration
llmConfig.securityList1: API Keys are not stored - entry required on each visit
llmConfig.securityList2: Keys remain only in browser memory while the tab is open
llmConfig.securityList3: Never share your API Keys with others
llmConfig.securityList4: For maximum security: Use Ollama locally (no API key needed)
llmConfig.learnMoreText: Browser-based apps cannot fully protect API Keys. The key is in the browser's memory during use. We recommend:
llmConfig.learnMoreList1: Create a separate API key only for this tool
llmConfig.learnMoreList2: Set spending limits with your provider
llmConfig.learnMoreList3: For sensitive documents: Use Ollama locally
llmConfig.localTipText: When running the tool locally, you can create a config.local.js file (see config.local.example.js). Your keys will then be loaded automatically.
llmConfig.acknowledge: I understand that my API key will be stored in browser memory during the session
llmConfig.persist: Store API key persistently (only on trusted devices)
llmConfig.modelHint: Gemini 3 Flash for fast results, Pro for complex handwriting.
llmConfig.ocrOnlyText: This model cannot validate text. Select a language model for validation or leave empty to use automatic fallback.
llmConfig.fallbackHint: Leave empty to use automatic fallback detection

transcribe.title: Start Transcription
transcribe.contextExplanation: Optional information about the document that will be considered during transcription.
transcribe.knownTextHint: If the source text is known, name it here for better correction proposals.
transcribe.contextInfoPlaceholder: e.g. Letter from the estate of Hugo Schuchardt to a colleague. Handwriting partially difficult to read, contains linguistic terminology.
transcribe.contextInfoHint: Describe origin, author, special features or other helpful information.
transcribe.stage1Placeholder: Optional custom prompt for Stage 1. Leave empty to use selected profile/default.
transcribe.profileHint: Select a document scenario. You can still override prompts manually.
transcribe.batchWarningText: Transcribing all pages may take several minutes and will consume API tokens.
transcribe.batchTokenCost: For {count} pages, approximately {tokens} token costs will be incurred.

describe.title: Describe Illuminated Initials
describe.promptPlaceholder: Enter custom prompt or use default...

validate.title: Start Validation
validate.batchWarningText: LLM Review for all pages may take several minutes.
validate.batchApiCalls: For {count} pages, multiple API calls will be made.

export.title: Export Transcription
export.jsonDesc: Full data with metadata and validation
export.pageXMLDesc: Standard format for Transkribus and other HTR tools
export.teiXMLDesc: TEI P5 format for digital editions and scholarly publishing

settings.title: Settings
settings.showHints: Show panel hints for new users
settings.storageHint: Images and transcriptions are stored in browser storage.

help.title: Help
help.step1Desc: Upload an image or load a demo document
help.step3Desc: Generate an image description for initials and iconography
help.step4Desc: Review Validation and LLM Review results
help.step5Desc: Download as TXT, JSON, or Markdown
help.markerHint: Use [?] for uncertain readings and [illegible] for unreadable text.

projects.title: Projects
projects.deleteWarning: This will permanently delete the project and all its data.

toast.apiKeyRequired: API key required. Click the model indicator to configure.

confirm.restoreInfo: A saved session was found from {time}.
confirm.deleteProjectText: Are you sure? This cannot be undone.
confirm.clearSessionText: This will remove all transcription data and start fresh.
